positions.question: Do you support increasing security along the southern US border?

evidence.text: "Just when you thought Joe Biden’s open-border policy reached its lowest point, this administration takes it a step further by selling off parts of the border wall. I have zero tolerance for these gimmicks. Unless the Biden Administration brings security to our border, I will be voting NO on @DHSgov funding."
"Since Joe Biden took office, over 1.3 MILLION illegal immigrants have got away from border patrol. The solution is straightforward: pass H.R. 2, increase border patrol, and finish the wall!"

"The Texas border with Mexico is open and in chaos, and the Biden administration’s open border policy is an intentional act of destabilization. Keith believes in going after cartel money in every banking institution where it is stashed, stopping non-governmental organizations from supporting the actual crossing operations, deploying sufficient Texas National Guard members to actually defend US sovereign territory, and if necessary, closing commercial traffic across the border in order to pressure Mexico to take stronger measures to stop the movement of illegal immigrants across their country."
Rated 91% by NumbersUSA

evidence.text: "Aliens that unlawfully cross our border should be detained and deterred from overtaking our communities.I applaud @GovAbbott for taking action on the historic crisis in spite of the President’s pro-invasion policies."
"Since Joe Biden took office, over 1.3 MILLION illegal immigrants have got away from border patrol. The solution is straightforward: pass H.R. 2, increase border patrol, and finish the wall!"

"This is what happens when Joe Biden provides entry and transportation for illegal immigrants into our cities and neighborhoods. We must secure our border before more families suffer the unspeakable horror that happened to Lizbeth."

positions.question: Do you support economic intervention as a means of resolving international conflicts?

evidence.text: "Hamas made their intentions clear – kill every single Israeli and establish a Jihadist Islamic Caliphate. They plan to repeat the horrific attacks committed on October 7, 2023 again and again. I am proud to support H.R. 340 that imposes stiffer sanctions on Hamas, states that support Hamas, and Iranian terror proxies."

"Iran and its proxies frequently use civilians and civilian infrastructure as shields for their covert terror operation, especially airlines and airports. That is why I introduced a resolution to urge the EU and NATO to sanction and refuse airport access for Iranian airlines that are complicit in Iran’s role as the leading state sponsor of terrorism."

"While it’s a relief that 5 Americans will return home to their families, paying Iran $6 billion for their release will only incentivize more hostage taking and fund this regime’s number one priority: terrorism. That is why I introduced the Iran Sanctions Relief Review Act (ISRRA) which would enable Congress to prevent destructive decisions from the Biden Administration."

positions.question: Do you support the US providing increased offensive military aid to Ukraine?

evidence.text: "Biden has requested $24 billion in aid to Ukraine and a measly $4 billion for our southern border. Unbelievable!"
"No funding for Ukraine"
Voted against HR 5692: "Ukraine Security Assistance and Oversight Supplemental Appropriations Act, 2024"

positions.question: Do you generally support increased regulations on social media companies (e.g. Tik Tok, Facebook, etc.)?

evidence.text: "Twitter allowed the Taliban to tweet, but banned an American president. Clearly, Big Tech poses a clear and present danger to freedom of speech and public debate in America. Selective censorship using shifting criteria must stop. Keith will fight to end the sweeping immunity given to the tech industry so that consumers have more legal tools to protect themselves."
Voted in favor of HR 7521 "Protecting Americans from Foreign Adversary Controlled Applications Act"
